name: tsa_createWorkerAndSession
description: First-time registration: validates that the invite is unused and unexpired, creates the TSA.Worker (name taken from the invite), opens a 90-day TSA.Session and marks the invite used, all in one transaction. Intended to run after OTP verification of @phoneNumber; the SP does not check that. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'createWorkerAndSession' to [TSA].[tsa_createWorkerAndSession]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: inviteId
parameters.description: Invite id from tsa_validateInviteToken. No default.

parameters.name: phoneNumber
parameters.description: E.164 phone number (OTP-verified by the caller). No default.

parameters.name: termsAcceptedAt
parameters.description: When the user accepted the T&Cs. No default; the column is NOT NULL so NULL fails in the INSERT.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Invite missing, used or expired (line 36, 'Invite is no longer valid.') or CATCH (line 62). Two columns only.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed user-facing text, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block (raw SQL Server text).

sideEffects: INSERT TSA.Session (one row, expiresAt = now + 90 days).

codeSmells.detail: @inviteId, @phoneNumber, @termsAcceptedAt (lines 2-4) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.
The CATCH (lines 60-63) returns the error envelope but writes nothing to HC.ErrorLog or any TSA log table, so failures are only visible in Azure Function logs as a 400 warning.

codeSmells.issue: Duplicate phone surfaces as a raw SQL error
codeSmells.detail: No check for an existing worker on @phoneNumber: a second invite registered to the same phone violates UQ_TSA_Worker_phone in the INSERT at line 43 and the user gets the raw constraint message as a 400.
The invite read at lines 27-31 takes no UPDLOCK; two concurrent registrations on one invite both pass and the second fails on UQ_TSA_Worker_invite with a raw SQL message.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
